steps.statement: Create the four world ProximityPrompts for PowerConsole, CoolantValve, CargoScanner, and EmergencyConsole.
Create the shared networking instances (Command, StateChanged, GetState) and the Protocol module in ReplicatedStorage/AirlockSystem.
Create the authoritative state machine server script in ServerScriptService/AirlockServer, managing phases, tween animations, prompt validations, rate limiting, and emergency cancellation.
Configure the HUD panel and create the technical readout labels, status indicators, and dispatch/reset buttons under StarterGui/AirlockHUD/Panel.
Create the client controller script in StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/AirlockClient to synchronize snapshots, drive HUD readouts, and send rate-limited allowlisted commands.
